course.title: Complex Variable, Vector Analysis and Statistics

content.value: Find the eigen values of the unequal scaling matrix operator of dimension 2 such that vector (10) is enlarged two times along x direction and 3 times along y direction. Also illustrate the effect of that operator on the geometrical figure whose corner points are (1,1), (1,3), (2,1), (2,3).
